config.parser: existing candidate parser; final content only; no repair
config.wrapper: official Chat Completions; original two-message transport; B appends delimited reference data to system; complete user message unchanged

final_interface.accepted: complete bare JSON object OR exactly one triple-backtick json/unlabelled fence; no other text
final_interface.content_mutations: none; only outer fence delimiters and exterior whitespace removed

analysis_rules.unit: 12 replies / 5 current contexts / 2 owners; repeat draws are dependent observations
analysis_rules.target_local_repair: 06B both B draws correctly identify the completed-action presupposition AND specific-source gap, both accurately use the reference, at least one contemporary A draw misses it; no confirmed new checking errors in completed controls. This is local only.
analysis_rules.coverage: Report all28, paired12, modelunknown, technical and review missing; a missing critical draw or unreviewed control makes the complete advancement assessment inconclusive.
analysis_rules.preserved_ambiguity: 04B two readings remain permitted; no unique severity or equal-utility target. Numerical stability and fact-interpretation stability are separate.
analysis_rules.prevent_overclaim: Correct relation does not establish a unique severity, correct resource winner, qualified reward or causal proof of extraction mechanism.
exits: reference adopted and local improvement: inspect old automatic E/S gaps before proposing C
reference not adopted: interface/reference/evidence-use investigation, not rubric verdict
reference adopted but score basis invalid: severity/q/evidence-to-score mapping
defensible readings and reasons: ambiguity numerical treatment
only06B improvement: local mechanism only, source-separated check needed
A ceiling/mixed/incomplete: inconclusive; no added draws
